answer: The valve assembly, its inlet and outlet, solenoid actuator, soil-moisture sensor, controller, and threshold-based closing operation are supported by paragraphs [0002]–[0003] and original claim 1. However, the provided materials do not disclose a wireless link, a remote device, or transmission of a leak alert. Paragraph [0004] describes a status lamp on the controller, which does not disclose the added remote wireless notification. Accordingly, the amendment is only partially supported by the materials provided.
question: Does the original application support all features added or recited in amended claim 1, including transmission of a wireless leak alert to a remote device? Cite the relevant passages.
amended_claims: 1. A field irrigation valve assembly comprising a valve body with an inlet and an outlet, a solenoid actuator, a soil-moisture sensor, and a controller connected to the actuator and sensor, wherein the controller closes the valve when a sensor reading exceeds a preset moisture threshold and transmits a leak alert over a wireless link to a remote device when the valve is closed.
original_claims: 1. A field irrigation valve assembly comprising a valve body with an inlet and an outlet, a solenoid actuator, a soil-moisture sensor, and a controller connected to the actuator and sensor, wherein the controller closes the valve when a sensor reading exceeds a preset moisture threshold.

original_application_text:
[0001] A field irrigation valve assembly controls water flow to a cultivation zone.
[0002] The assembly has a valve body with an inlet and outlet, a solenoid actuator, a soil-moisture sensor positioned in the zone, and a controller connected to the actuator and sensor.
[0003] The controller compares the sensor reading with a preset moisture threshold and energizes the solenoid to close the valve when the reading exceeds that threshold.
[0004] A status lamp on the controller illuminates while the valve is closed.
